info.title: axm
info.description: Build, test, and debug your AI coding environment like software.

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Check the repo's health: its instruction files in any repo, and every asset when it holds a vault.

commands.name: explain
commands.description: Show which instruction files each harness loads for a file, and which it drops, each with its rule.

options.name: --cwd
options.description: Where the harness starts. Defaults to the repo root, or the current directory outside a repo.

options.name: --diff
options.description: Only the files one harness loads and the other doesn't.

options.name: --json
options.description: Print JSON. Its shape is a contract, versioned by schemaVersion.

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: The file to explain. It needn't exist yet, but its folder must.

commands.name: hook
commands.description: Hooks for Claude Code to run. Each reads the hook's JSON on stdin.

commands.name: scope-sheriff
commands.description: Warn the agent when an edit leaves the task's scope in .axm/scope.

commands.name: session-doctor
commands.description: When a session starts, tell the user and the model what axm doctor finds wrong. Silent when all is well.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List the vault's assets by kind, with maturity, version and harness support.

commands.name: triggers
commands.description: Find skills whose descriptions overlap in each harness's listing, and the terms they share.

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Check every asset and print only the problems, for CI and hooks.
